summary: M05 implements the comparison scope (LA-6) as a chain of scope filters behind a published facade, with inputs taken only from verified context (M01 tie-ups and entity type, M02 selling scope). Admin writes are operator-only, audited and emit id-only events; the app role has read-only grants on the platform catalogue. All 10 acceptance criteria are traced to tests; one traceability claim (assertInScope) was false at review time and has since been covered. Branch coverage in the backend (73.8%) is the weakest metric; Postgres repositories are not yet implemented (in-memory adapters only).

findings.summary: ScopeInput.tiedInsurerIds is Partial<Record<LineOfBusiness, string[]>> while spec shows Record<LineOfBusiness, string[]>; implementation is defensively more correct (handles missing lines), filter uses optional chaining (?.)
findings.resolution: Architect: deliberate — a tenant may have no tie-up for a line; the TieUpFilter treats a missing line as no tied insurers.
